branch_name_note: The branch name 'overnight/integration' is historical only. Keep using it and do not rename it; it no longer implies an overnight window.

base.verified: main contains only README.md; nothing to break

rules: Automated merges into main are ALLOWED only once independently proven: an independent review approves the exact candidate SHA AND every other acceptance condition (AC2-AC5) is met for that same SHA (source: PR #27 finding C6, reflecting Ian's later authorization).
Final human portfolio acceptance is a separate gate (AC6). Technical eligibility for merge does not mean portfolio acceptance.

Technical blockers are not relaxed by this policy: failing or missing checks, unapproved security exceptions, the PR #6 self-logging defect, docs mismatches, and the open review findings (PR #14 B5-1/B5-2, PR #27 C1-C5) all still block.
This integration agent does not merge anything into main itself, and makes no production changes.
PRs are not closed by integration
Review identity strings alone are not authenticated approval. Bind reviewer evidence to the exact SHA through GitHub review or commit provenance (PR #27 C4).
